description: Bus Ridership PW is a dataset listed in City of Roseville open data portal (data.roseville.ca.us), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Roseville. Number of people who ride the bus on various routes including: Dial a Ride, Local Routes, Commuter Routes. Coverage: Roseville, California. The portal files it under the category Public Works. Its tags are riders, bus, local bus. The table has 6 columns. Attribution on the portal: Public Works. The portal shows 2026-09-01 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-roseville-ca-us-portal.
